description: AMBIGUOUS: module constant MAX_POOL_SIZE raised from 8 to 16; the ConnectionPool(size=8) constructor default is unchanged. The FAQ says 'the pool tops out at 8 connections per host in the default setup' without naming either — before the change that was true of BOTH. Whether the FAQ is now wrong depends on which one it paraphrases; the correct verdict is unsure + a question. The connection-pools page names MAX_POOL_SIZE explicitly and stays a normal drifted section.
